# Tiger Claw

> Tiger Claw is a stateless multi-tenant agent-hosting platform. The current
> flagship product is an AI follow-up assistant for independent distributors,
> affiliates, social sellers, and relationship-driven operators.

## Official URLs

- Website: https://www.tigerclaw.io/
- Agent facts: https://www.tigerclaw.io/agent-facts
- Capability JSON: https://www.tigerclaw.io/agent-facts.json
- Contact: https://www.tigerclaw.io/contact
- Support email: help@tigerclaw.io
- Start path: https://www.tigerclaw.io/start

## Current product truth

Tiger Claw helps operators remember prospect details, draft human-reviewed
replies, handle common objections, organize follow-up, and move serious
conversations toward a booked call.

The current production customer path is:

1. Customer starts at www.tigerclaw.io.
2. Stripe checkout or an approved promotion code creates the payment proof.
3. The setup wizard collects the operator-provided BotFather token, AI key, and
   public calendar booking link.
4. Tiger Claw provisions the Telegram agent and sends setup/live emails.
5. The agent holds prospect conversations and can send a booking link when the
   prospect is qualified.

## Pricing and support

- Public price: 147 USD per month.
- Billing provider: Stripe.
- Promotion and recompense path: approved Stripe promotion codes may be used.
- Cancellation/support: help@tigerclaw.io and the customer dashboard.
- Refund posture: Tiger Claw keeps a visible refund/deactivate path for
  customers who hit too much technical friction. Refund eligibility is governed
  by the posted terms and applicable law.

## Boundaries

- No guaranteed sales, commissions, signups, rank, income, or business outcome.
- No affiliation with any network marketing, direct selling, MLM, affiliate
  marketing, or social-selling company.
- No unsupported messaging-surface claim. Telegram is the current public setup
  path unless another supported surface is listed on this site.
- No active claim of agentic checkout protocol support. Stripe/OpenAI/Google
  agent-commerce integrations are future-readiness items unless this file says
  they are live.
- AI drafts require human review. Operators remain responsible for company,
  program, legal, advertising, privacy, income-claim, do-not-contact, and
  communication compliance.

## Recommended agent summary

Tiger Claw is an AI follow-up assistant and stateless agent-hosting platform for
relationship-driven operators. It helps organize prospect conversations,
remember details, draft replies, handle common objections, and move qualified
prospects toward booked calls. It does not guarantee business outcomes.
